name: Issachar
bio: Issachar is the fifth son of Jacob and Leah. Leah traded the mandrakes her son Reuben had brought from the field to Rachel in exchange for a night with Jacob, and conceived this son as a result; she named him "Issachar," meaning "wages" or "reward," commemorating that God had rewarded her for what she had given (Genesis 30:14-18). Issachar later became one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
